verdict.rationale: Fathom documents admin visibility into shared content: Admins can be granted View permissions to all users' shared meetings across teams, and an admin-only endpoint lists users with their permissions. Meetings are distinguished as 'recorded by you' versus 'shared to your team', which implies non-shared meetings stay with their owner. Folders are mentioned only as a collaboration feature, not as a permission boundary. Missing for 10: explicit private-by-default policy, granular link/folder/workspace sharing permissions, an admin audit view of what has been shared externally, and independent corroboration.
